# PrismHR Help — Complete Documentation

> Public, crawlable copy of PrismHR product documentation for payroll, benefits, HR, billing, compliance, and system administration.  
> Source: https://tech-docs.prismhr.com/SP_help/Default.htm  
> Build date: August 5, 2026 (PrismHR 26.07)

## About

This site contains the complete PrismHR product help documentation in plain HTML, suitable for use by AI agents and search engines. All pages are static HTML with no JavaScript dependency.

## Sections

### Core Operations

- **Payroll** — Process payroll, pay groups, deductions, taxes, vouchers, and payroll reporting  
  https://bcrccompani-ui.github.io/prismhr-help/payroll.html

- **Benefits Administration** — Group benefit plans, COBRA, ACA, enrollment, carrier files  
  https://bcrccompani-ui.github.io/prismhr-help/benefits.html

- **Human Resources** — Employee records, positions, I-9, workers' comp, training  
  https://bcrccompani-ui.github.io/prismhr-help/human-resources.html

- **Time Off and PTO** — Vacation, sick leave, PTO accruals, time-off requests  
  https://bcrccompani-ui.github.io/prismhr-help/time-off.html
